definition_en: an electronic machine for working with data and the internet
example: I use my computer to write emails to my friends.

definition_en: the glass part of a computer that shows pictures and words
example: Look at the computer screen to see the message.

definition_en: a small device you move with your hand to click on a computer
example: Click the left button on the mouse to open the file.

definition_en: a board with letters and numbers used to write on a computer
example: Type your name carefully using the keyboard.

definition_en: a machine that prints words and pictures on paper
example: We need more paper for the school printer.

definition_en: a machine that copies pictures into a computer
example: Use the scanner to put your drawing onto the computer.

definition_en: the tall box of a desktop computer with the main parts
example: Press the power button on the computer tower.

definition_en: a small tool you speak into to record your voice
example: Speak into the microphone so your online friends can hear you.

definition_en: a pair of small speakers you wear over your ears
example: Put on your headphones to listen to the dialogue.

definition_en: a device that plays sounds from a computer
example: Turn up the computer speaker to hear the song.

definition_en: a world network that connects computers together
example: You can find interesting facts on the internet.

definition_en: a message sent through the internet from one computer to another
example: Kostas sent an email to his pen-pal in Ireland.

definition_en: a place on the internet with pictures and information
example: Our school has a website with photos of sports day.

definition_en: connected to the internet or available on the computer network
example: Mark is online and chatting with Nadine.

definition_en: to talk in a friendly way with someone online or in person
example: Children chat about their favourite school subjects.

definition_en: to look at different websites on the internet
example: I like to surf the net on Saturday afternoons.

definition_en: facts or details about a person, place, or thing
example: We searched for information about animals in Europe.

definition_en: to make a message or letter go to someone else
example: Please send me an email when you arrive.

definition_en: to get something that someone sends to you
example: I receive many messages from my friends.

definition_en: time when you do not have to work or study
example: What do you like doing in your free time?

definition_en: an activity you enjoy doing in your free time
example: My favourite hobby is playing basketball.

definition_en: to like one thing more than another thing
example: I prefer reading books to watching television.

definition_en: to feel happy when you do an activity
example: Three pupils enjoy playing computer games together.

definition_en: to dislike something very much
example: Mark hates doing difficult tests on Monday morning.

definition_en: to make pictures with a pen or pencil
example: You can draw a colourful picture on paper.

definition_en: a game or problem that tests your clever thinking
example: I like doing a crossword puzzle after dinner.

definition_en: a physical game like football or tennis that you play
example: Swimming is a great sport for children.

definition_en: cleaning and cooking that people do at home
example: I help my parents with the housework on Saturdays.

definition_en: to run slowly for exercise and good health
example: Susan likes to jog in the park near her house.

definition_en: to make a picture using liquid colors and a brush
example: I paint pictures of mountains in art class.

definition_en: to learn about a subject at school or at home
example: Nadine loves to study English and French.

definition_en: school work that pupils do at home after class
example: Always finish your homework before you play games.

definition_en: a set of questions to see how much you know
example: We have an English test next Friday.

definition_en: a child who is learning at a primary school
example: Kostas is an eleven-year-old pupil in the 5th grade.

definition_en: a person who studies at a school or college
example: Nadine is a student in the second year of Collège.

definition_en: a school for children aged between 5 and 11
example: Mark goes to a primary school in London.

definition_en: an area of land with its own people and government
example: Greece is a beautiful country in southern Europe.

definition_en: the country that a person belongs to by law
example: What nationality is your new internet friend?

definition_en: the main city where the government of a country works
example: London is the capital of the United Kingdom.

definition_en: a piece of cloth with special colors that represents a country
example: The Greek flag is blue and white.

definition_en: a piece of land with water all around it
example: Crete is the largest island in Greece.

definition_en: the total number of people living in a place
example: The population of the United Kingdom is about 59 million.

definition_en: to touch the edge of another country on a map
example: Spain borders Portugal on the Iberian Peninsula.

definition_en: the large island with England, Scotland, and Wales
example: Mark lives on the island of Great Britain.

definition_en: the country of England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland
example: London is the capital of the United Kingdom.

definition_en: a historic country in southern Europe where Kostas lives
example: Kostas is from Athens in Greece.

definition_en: a large country in western Europe where Nadine lives
example: Nadine is from Marseilles in the south of France.

definition_en: a warm country in southwestern Europe next to Portugal
example: Carmen and Pedro live in sunny Spain.

definition_en: relating to Great Britain and its people
example: Mark is a British boy living in London.

definition_en: relating to Greece, its people, or its language
example: Kostas is Greek and he speaks Greek and English.

definition_en: relating to France, its people, or its language
example: Nadine speaks French with her classmates at Collège.

definition_en: relating to Spain, its people, or its language
example: Pedro is Spanish and he lives in Barcelona.

definition_en: relating to Italy, its people, or its language
example: Isabella is Italian and lives in Rome.

definition_en: relating to Germany, its people, or its language
example: Gunther is German and he lives in Berlin.

definition_en: relating to Holland, its people, or its language
example: Hans is Dutch and he comes from Amsterdam.

definition_en: relating to Russia, its people, or its language
example: Svetlana is Russian and lives in Moscow.

definition_en: a sign or object that represents an idea or country
example: The black cab is a famous symbol of London.

definition_en: a special flower that represents a nation
example: Each country in Britain has its own national flower.

definition_en: a sweet-smelling flower that is the symbol of England
example: The red rose is the national flower of England.

definition_en: a yellow spring flower that is the symbol of Wales
example: A bright yellow daffodil grows in the fields of Wales.

definition_en: a prickly purple plant that is the symbol of Scotland
example: The purple thistle is the proud symbol of Scotland.

definition_en: a small plant with three green leaves that represents Ireland
example: The green shamrock is the national plant of Ireland.
